name: Children Returning Home
overview: Scripture reveals God's promise of restoration and deliverance for His children who have been scattered or held captive. Isaiah assures that the children will hasten home and be saved from their oppressors, as God contends for them and brings liberty to the bound. Jeremiah echoes this hope, affirming that the children will return to their own land. Luke’s account of the prodigal son illustrates the spiritual awakening and repentance that leads to a joyful return to the Father's house, emphasizing God's grace in restoring His children.
